column1: # name: British government bond total return (10-year benchmark
# source: OECD long-term government bond yield GBR.M.IRLT (dataflow DSD_STES@DF_FINMARK
column2: ~1960) run through TreasuryTR (10y par); via DBnomics. British leg of the NTSG global bond overlay; monthly texture accepted
column3: the sleeve is ~1.8% of net assets. No real daily or month-end gilt curve is spliced in front of it
column4: unlike the German leg: the Bank of England publishes its daily curve as a workbook rather than a series
column5: so this file carries the month-average cadence end to end. CADENCE: the OECD observation for a month is that month's AVERAGE of the daily quotes
column6: so the level is reached mid-month and its monthly returns are smoothed. The label is the month's last day
column7: the convention every other monthly series here carries
column8: so that the file's steps and its junction with a real month-end segment are one month each; it is a name for the month
column9: not a claim that the level is a month-end close.
